# meshmsg v0.1.21

This release makes protocol v3 the single canonical meshmsg protocol, raises public broadcast capacity to one bounded 64 KiB signed envelope, and removes obsolete compatibility surfaces.

## Protocol and compatibility

- Makes protocol v3 canonical for signed broadcast envelopes and local IPC, with no V2 negotiation, downgrade, or fallback.
- Moves broadcasts to the V3 `/meshmsg/broadcast-gossip/3` ALPN and sends each complete signed envelope as one direct Iroh Gossip application message, without application chunking or reassembly.
- Sets the exact signed-envelope maximum to 65,536 bytes and the maximum broadcast body to 65,358 UTF-8 bytes, with tested encoding boundaries and bounded transport admission.
- Leaves the private/direct-message contract unchanged at a 4,096-byte body and 6 KiB frame.
- This is intentionally incompatible with V2. All clients and daemons must reinstall and restart together; mixed-version operation is rejected rather than downgraded.

## Removed surfaces

- Removes diagnostic-status negotiation, the `meshmsg diagnostics` command, and related diagnostics compatibility contracts.
- Removes daemon stdout/JSON event mirroring; subscribers continue to receive bounded local IPC events.
- Removes the `--no-alias` option and `alias disable`; aliases can still be cleared or overridden through the remaining canonical commands.
- Removes the `peer_up` and `peer_down` local IPC events in favor of the canonical peer lifecycle and snapshot contracts.
- Removes the web bridge and UI.
- Removes benchmark tooling and the benchmark TUI/binary.
- Removes migration of legacy local-state formats; unsupported historical state now fails closed instead of being migrated.

## Security and attachments

- Retains strict attachment-token validation, bounded attachment and IPC fields, absolute UTF-8 path validation, owner-authenticated local IPC, fail-closed framing, replay controls, and per-source/global transport resource limits.
- Keeps attachment delivery on the same signed, topic-bound V3 envelope contract and preserves existing download integrity and lifecycle hardening.
- Topic-wide broadcasts and attachment offers remain plaintext to every invite holder; topic membership is the confidentiality boundary.
- Iroh may cache or forward one bounded Gossip item before meshmsg performs signature and semantic admission.
- Post-delivery authenticated-hop byte throttling bounds local work but does not provide global Sybil resistance.

Install this exact source release after the tag is published:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.21 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.20...v0.1.21
